tasks.short: Review industrial practices for environmental hazards and liabilities

steps.what: Read actual construction/production methods, material specifications and environmental history for the industrial practice review
inputs: actual industrial methods and material records
actual site/process history and relevant hazard evidence

steps.what: Examine actual industrial practices and clarify how methods/materials are used under real operating conditions
inputs: ecologist-checked practice evidence and gaps
actual industrial operations and personnel explanations
outputs: actual observed practice conditions and evidence

steps.what: Identify potential environmental hazards and liabilities from the actual reviewed practices and evidence limitations
inputs: actual observed practice conditions and evidence
ecologist-checked practice evidence and gaps
outputs: ecologist's potential hazard/liability findings and uncertainties

steps.what: Complete and check actual hazard-review findings and supporting evidence references in the review record
inputs: ecologist's potential hazard/liability findings and uncertainties
actual observed practice conditions and evidence
outputs: complete checked industrial practice hazard-review record

steps.what: Save the completed checked industrial practice hazard-review record
inputs: complete checked industrial practice hazard-review record

tasks.design: Configure native method/material/history links in {OTHER}, the industrial environmental review application, and {DOCS}. The ecologist reads actual evidence, examines practices and identifies potential hazards, then writes/checks the actual review record before saving; no hazard or legal liability conclusion is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation among actual method, material and history records can interrupt review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can bring existing practice evidence together.
tasks.still_hard: Actual exposure, implementation and evidential sufficiency may differ from written methods.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a hazard concealed by an apparently acceptable specification.

ambition.what: No automatic hazard clearance or legal determination.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for practice/site records and review permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native practice-source links can reduce navigation while actual hazard review requires contextual professional judgment.

assumptions: Shares describe unmeasured actual practice review with its findings record, not an invented report after every site visit.
Operators supply actual methods/materials/history; the ecologist obtains observations in s2 and records findings in s4. Missing data require investigation, not a free structured hazard feed.
Only source navigation changes; actual observation and record writing remain fully retained. Equivalent current links remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 2.5 minus 0.75 hour of source-link upkeep gives 1.75 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
Final findings are checked during ordinary record completion. No enforcement notice or external send is assumed.
research_questions: Do actual reviews repeat evidence navigation beyond current native tools?

approvals.approved_version: complete checked industrial practice hazard-review record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.75%; observation, assessment and findings entry remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply ecosystem research to economic and industrial understanding

steps.what: Find and read actual new or existing natural-ecosystem research relevant to the economic/industrial system question
inputs: actual economic/industrial system question
actual ecosystem research publications and source dates
outputs: ecologist-read ecosystem research and evidence limits

steps.what: Apply the actual ecosystem research to understand economic and industrial systems in environmental context, testing transfer limits
inputs: ecologist-read ecosystem research and evidence limits
actual economic/industrial system characteristics
outputs: ecologist's contextual understanding and limits of ecosystem analogy

tasks.design: Configure native saved searches and source links in {OTHER}, the research/reference application, to assist actual discovery. The ecologist reads research and tests how ecosystem findings apply to the actual economic/industrial system using {DOCS}; the configuration neither asserts that an analogy transfers nor adds a report or send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated research discovery can interrupt investigation of relevant ecosystem concepts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source filters can reduce search navigation while retaining actual reading.
tasks.still_hard: An ecosystem relationship may not hold under economic institutions or industrial controls.
tasks.human_edge: Reject an appealing analogy when its causal conditions do not transfer.

ambition.what: No automatic conceptual conclusion or additional research output.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research filters can reduce discovery navigation while applying ecosystem findings across domains remains expert reasoning.

assumptions: Shares are provisional research/interpretation effort, not a measured baseline or prompt prior.
Publishers supply actual research; system owners supply actual system characteristics. Source capture and relevance checking remain in s1; missing evidence is investigated manually.
Only discovery navigation changes; all substantive reading and transfer reasoning remain. Equivalent current searches remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 4.5 minus 0.75 hour of search/source upkeep gives 3.75 net. This understanding-focused episode has no separate record commit or communication to automate.
unknowns: Current search configuration and relevance yield
research_questions: Do saved source filters remove repeated search effort without narrowing relevant evidence?

already_counted.description: Read and check actual ecosystem research

incremental.description: Maintain research filters and source links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.75%; substantive research reading and cross-system reasoning remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review actual renewable-resource stocks, regeneration evidence, use pressures and management objectives
inputs: actual resource condition/regeneration evidence
actual use pressures, rights and management objectives

steps.what: Develop actual renewable-resource management actions, use limits, monitoring and adaptive responses
inputs: ecologist-checked renewable-resource evidence and constraints
actual ecological uncertainty and stakeholder needs
outputs: ecologist's resource management decisions and rationale

steps.what: Prepare and check the actual renewable-resource management plan with supporting maps, references and uncertainty
inputs: ecologist's resource management decisions and rationale
ecologist-checked renewable-resource evidence and constraints

steps.what: Save the completed checked renewable-resource management plan
inputs: complete checked renewable-resource management plan

tasks.design: Configure native resource evidence views in {OTHER}, the GIS/resource assessment application, and linked source/map fields in {DOCS}. The ecologist chooses real management actions and writes/checks the plan before saving; reference handling changes while regeneration and sustainable-use judgments stay with the ecologist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence navigation and map/reference handling can interrupt plan preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native GIS/document links can reuse actual source identity and maps.
tasks.still_hard: Regeneration uncertainty and competing uses complicate a defensible resource plan.
tasks.human_edge: Set adaptive management conditions when evidence cannot justify a fixed use limit.

ambition.what: No automatic resource allocation or plan adoption.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for actual resource evidence and responsible manager consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native resource and document links can reduce handling while renewable-resource strategy remains professional judgment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional plan-preparation effort, not measured resource-management baselines.
Field/resource owners supply actual stocks, use and regeneration evidence; the ecologist investigates gaps in s1 and defines management assumptions in s2. No free new monitoring data is assumed.
Only source/map handling changes. Narrative management choices and checking remain retained; equivalent current links remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 4.45 minus 1 hour of evidence/map-link upkeep gives 3.45 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
This produces the actual plan; formal adoption, resource commitments or external sends remain existing separate responsible actions.
unknowns: Actual evidence completeness and current document links
research_questions: Does real plan writing repeat source/map handling beyond native tools?

already_counted.description: Review resource evidence and prepare/check actual plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.45%; actual management decisions and substantive plan writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify system components and compare their relationships

steps.what: Inspect actual industrial, social and natural system descriptions and evidence of component interactions
inputs: actual system descriptions and analysis question
actual process, social and ecological evidence

steps.what: Identify and map actual component parts and relationships across industrial, social and natural systems
inputs: ecologist-checked system evidence and gaps
ecologist-selected component boundaries and relationship definitions

steps.what: Compare component relationships, challenge unsupported links and complete the checked system map and interpretation
inputs: draft actual system component/relationship map
ecologist-checked system evidence and gaps
outputs: complete checked system component/relationship map and comparison

steps.what: Save the completed checked system component/relationship map and comparison
inputs: complete checked system component/relationship map and comparison

tasks.design: Configure native source links and reusable node/edge styles in {OTHER}, the systems mapping application. The ecologist identifies and enters actual components/relationships, using native layout for presentation, then checks meaning and comparison in {DOCS} before saving; the software does not infer a causal relationship.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and diagram formatting can distract from system comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and reusable mapping styles can reduce presentation handling.
tasks.still_hard: A drawn connection may hide weak evidence, different scales or an unsupported causal claim.
tasks.human_edge: Separate a documented relationship from a convenient conceptual link.

ambition.what: No automatic causal model or intervention choice.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for system evidence and mapping access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source links and mapping styles can reduce diagram handling while component identification and relationship interpretation remain expert work.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured actual mapping/comparison exercise, not a mandated extra diagram for every conceptual question.

System owners/research sources supply actual evidence; the ecologist selects boundaries and manually identifies/enters components and links in s1/s2. No unproduced structured relationship table is assumed.
Only navigation and diagram formatting change. The native layout does not create relationship content; equivalent current styles/links remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 7 minus 1 hour of source/style upkeep gives 6 net. The negligible save earns no gain.
Final semantic checking occurs during ordinary map completion in s3; no separate self-approval is added.
unknowns: Actual map-formatting burden and relationship evidence
research_questions: Do reusable mapping styles reduce real analysis effort after all semantic identification and checking?

already_counted.description: Identify/map actual components and check relationship meaning

incremental.description: Maintain source links and reusable map styles

approvals.approved_version: complete checked system component/relationship map and comparison

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 6%; actual component/relationship identification and interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
